items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: He was with the band. He was playing with the band. Yeah. With the Navy Band.

ctx.x: all over. All parts. Cleveland, New York, Chicago. Where was that, uh, that picture you had
there with, uh, what's his name? Nelson. With Nelson? Yeah. Well, that was in, uh,

MacAlestock, Oklahoma. And he was traveling with the band then? He was with the band. He was playing with the band. Yeah. With the Navy Band. Was there any more New Orleans musicians in that band? In that band, Larry. Hubbert Larry? No, no, not Hubbert Larry. Jimmy Larry. Oh, no. Jimmy Larry. Oh, no. Jimmy Larry. Any more besides that? No, that was the only, we was the only three from New Orleans in that band. What band was that, the proper name of that band? The New Orleans, the United States Neighbor Band. Oh,…
